name: phil/paged-media-bundle
description: phil/paged-media in Symfony: the native PDF writer and Gotenberg behind one service, Gotenberg's URL, credentials, signing certificate and timestamp authority from the configuration, templates by attribute or by name, and Messenger messages that render, run PDF stages or convert office documents

suggest.phil/footnotes-sidenotes: For the notes of a UJO (Universal JSON Output) document at the foot of the printed page
suggest.phil/paged-media-weasyprint: For a print engine ready to use, on the weasyprint command
suggest.psr/cache: For the job store in a cache pool shared by every worker
suggest.psr/event-dispatcher: To learn when a file rendered by a message is kept
suggest.symfony/http-client: For the Gotenberg client and the vault certificate source
suggest.symfony/messenger: To render, run stages and convert asynchronously
